answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a bond and slash it when peers catch one agent attesting for many forged duplicates, making each extra persona burn real stake rather than earn rewards, so an attacker spinning up a thousand agents at the wharf of the network must fund a thousand bonds and accepts that one fraud report turns the whole umber-colored pile of collateral into penalties, a cost curve the old fable of free identities never priced in.
